tools.name: check_certificate
tools.description: Checks a certificate of insurance (ACORD 25) against insurance requirements with CertifiKit's deterministic rules engine: coverage present, limits at or above the minimums, policies not expired or expiring too soon, and the required endorsements. Read the certificate yourself and pass what it shows;

tools.description: The ready-made insurance requirement sets check_certificate accepts as preset: a standard construction subcontractor and a property / HOA vendor, with every limit and endorsement spelled out.
